items.title: 微軟發布AI使用報告 台灣AI使用率33.8%全球排名前進至第19
items.title_en: Microsoft Releases AI Usage Report; Taiwan AI Usage Rate 33.8% Rises to 19th Globally
paras: 微軟(MSFT-US)發布全球AI使用報告，全球第二季AI使用率為18.8%，季增1個百分點，其中，台灣第二季AI使用率為33.8%，季增2個百分點，全球排名從20名提升至19名。
微軟指出，AI普及率(AI diffusion)為統計期間內，全球15至64歲人口中，曾經使用生成式AI產品的比例。根據報告，第二季全球AI使用率持續攀升，全球勞動年齡人口中，使用AI的比例達18.8%，較第一季高出1個百分點，且幾乎所有的經濟體AI使用量皆有所提升。
全球AI使用率最高的國家為阿拉伯聯合大公國，使用率達73.3%；其次為新加坡，使用率64.3%；第三名為愛爾蘭，使用率49.9%；第四名為法國，使用率49.6%；第五名為挪威，使用率49.4%。
值得注意的是，南韓第二季AI使用率為40.6%，較第一季提升3.5個百分點，再度成為AI使用率絕對增幅最大的經濟體；沙烏地阿拉伯排名從30名提升至25名，排名增幅最大；日本則是相對增幅最大，AI使用率季增2.2個百分點，相較於第一季約成長10%。
另外，開放權重模型(Open-weight models)正在快速崛起，並擴大AI應用範圍。微軟指出，開放權重模型會釋出訓練後的模型權重，開發者或組織可以自行下載、修改，相較於只能透過專有服務使用的封閉模型，具有更高的部署與客製化自由度。
微軟進一步提到，開放權重的使用狀況，可能無法捕捉一般消費者端的AI使用率的使用全貌，因此API的使用可作為觀察AI普及程度的角度。針對開放權重模型的使用情況，根據OpenRouter公開資料，開放權重模型已占OpenRouter token使用量約75%。
整體而言，微軟認為，雖這些數據不能代表全球市場占有率，但開放權重模型成為以API為基礎的AI經濟中愈來愈重義的一環，市場也愈來愈廣泛採用開放權重模型。
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) released a global AI usage report showing that the worldwide AI usage rate for Q2 was 18.8%, up one percentage point quarter‑over‑quarter. Taiwan’s AI usage rate for Q2 was 33.8%, up two percentage points, moving the country from 20th to 19th place globally.

Microsoft defined AI diffusion as the proportion of the global population aged 15‑64 who have ever used a generative AI product during the measurement period. The report indicates that the global AI usage rate continued to climb in Q2, reaching 18.8% of the working‑age population, a one‑point increase from Q1, with almost every economy showing higher AI usage.
The highest AI usage rates were recorded in the United Arab Emirates at 73.3%, followed by Singapore at 64.3%, Ireland at 49.9%, France at 49.6% and Norway at 49.4%.

Notably, South Korea’s Q2 AI usage rate was 40.6%, a 3.5‑point rise from Q1, making it the economy with the largest absolute increase; Saudi Arabia jumped from 30th to 25th place, the biggest ranking gain; Japan posted the largest relative gain, with a 2.2‑point quarterly increase, roughly a 10% rise from Q1.

In addition, open‑weight models are rapidly emerging and expanding the scope of AI applications. Microsoft explained that open‑weight models release the trained model weights, allowing developers or organizations to download and modify them, offering greater deployment and customization flexibility compared with closed models that can only be accessed via proprietary services.

Microsoft added that usage of open‑weight models may not fully capture consumer‑side AI usage, so API usage can serve as an indicator of AI diffusion. According to publicly available OpenRouter data, open‑weight models now account for about 75% of OpenRouter token usage.

Overall, Microsoft believes that while these figures do not represent global market share, open‑weight models are becoming an increasingly important component of the API‑driven AI economy, and the market is adopting open‑weight models more broadly.

items.title: 英特爾跨入Micro LED CPO 台LED廠迎AI矽光子商機
items.title_en: Intel Enters Micro LED CPO; Taiwan LED Factories Eye AI Silicon-Photon Opportunities
paras: 隨著AI資料中心高密度傳輸與低能耗的要求日益嚴苛，Micro LED CPO 技術獲得半導體巨擘高度青睞，市場消息指出，英特爾(INTC-US)近期在Micro LED CPO領域與布局的面板大廠友達(2409-TW)展開合作，隨著 Micro LED CPO 獲重視，台廠富采(3714-TW)、錼創(6854-TW)、鼎元(2426-TW)、光鋐(4956-TW)已積極切入布局。
Micro LED CPO 過去便獲科技巨頭重視，聯發科(2454-TW)於今年3月率先宣布與微軟(MSFT-US)研究院等夥伴成功研發出Micro LED次世代主動式光纜(AOC)，透過微軟技術與聯發科單晶互補式金屬氧化物半導體(CMOS)整合，具備銅纜等級的高可靠度，並且在相同頻寬下實現省電50%的突破。
英特爾近期將技術由Micro LED推進至晶片先進封裝層次。英特爾所獲專利核心在於將Micro LED預先嵌入IC封裝的玻璃基板內，透過TGV技術實現電氣互連，為CPO與高密度算力提供新解決方案，因而找上具備貫穿玻璃通孔、重分布層(RDL)與模組整合技術達三十年的友達展開合作。
Micro LED在光通訊領域受矚目原因，是在資料中心機櫃內十公尺以下的短距離傳輸場景中，相較於傳統雷射光源僅能耐受攝氏75度且故障率高達銅纜的一百倍，Micro LED具備耐熱達攝氏120度與壽命超過三萬小時等物理特性。
且 Micro LED 能耗是主流垂直共振腔面射型雷射(VCSEL)的十分之一、矽光方案的五分之一，並可將1.6Tbps光收發模組功耗由傳統雷射方案的30瓦驟降至約1.6瓦，改善AI算力中心的散熱負擔與營運成本。
國際研調機構評估，隨著傳輸架構由銅導線走向光訊號，CPO模組市場規模將自2025年的1.1億美元，大幅增長至2033年的19.6億美元，其中Micro LED模組最快可望在2028年下半年放量，2030年產值上看8.48億美元。
台灣 LED 陣營憑藉深厚的晶片磊晶、巨量轉移與光電整合實力，成為次世代光通訊技術落地的核心推手。富采與鼎元攜手友達打造系統級光學模組，富采主打極低功耗、耐高溫達攝氏120度且長壽命的Micro LED光源，成功突破頻寬限制通過商用標準。
鼎元則主攻砷化鎵(GaAs)與磷化銦(InGaAs)光電二極體(PD)及微型接收元件，更規劃投入12億元資本支出擴建無塵室產線以備戰高階光通訊訂單。
Micro LED廠錼創-KY則鎖定資料中心機櫃內短距離光互連，以數百顆微米發光二極體陣列化平行傳輸彌補單顆速度差距，憑藉低功耗與對光纖入射角度容忍度高、對準成本低等優勢，積極與夥伴推進光纖耦合技術，目標在兩年內由技術可行推向商業可行。
磊晶廠光鋐亦全面加速轉型，跳脫傳統LED紅海競爭，研發計畫正式納入光通訊用Micro LED、短波紅外光LED及垂直共振腔面射型雷射(VCSEL)，積極由既有晶粒延伸至不同波段的光電元件應用，合力構築台灣在次世代光傳輸光源端的完整版圖。
paras_en: As AI data centers demand ever‑higher density transmission and lower power consumption, Micro LED CPO technology has attracted strong interest from semiconductor giants. Market sources say Intel (INTC‑US) has recently begun cooperating with panel maker AU Optronics (2409‑TW) on Micro LED CPO, and as the technology gains traction, Taiwanese firms Foxlink (3714‑TW), NXP (6854‑TW), Dingtian (2426‑TW) and Guanghong (4956‑TW) are already moving to position themselves.

Micro LED CPO has long been on the radar of tech leaders. In March this year, MediaTek (2454‑TW) announced that, together with Microsoft Research (MSFT‑US) and other partners, it had successfully developed a next‑generation active optical cable (AOC) based on Micro LED. By integrating Microsoft’s technology with MediaTek’s complementary‑metal‑oxide‑semiconductor (CMOS) chips, the solution achieves copper‑cable‑level reliability and cuts power consumption by 50% at the same bandwidth.

Intel is now pushing the technology beyond Micro LED to advanced chip‑level packaging. The core of Intel’s patented approach embeds Micro LED devices into the glass substrate of an IC package and uses through‑glass via (TGV) technology for electrical interconnects, offering a new solution for CPO and high‑density compute. For this, Intel has partnered with AU Optronics, which brings 30 years of expertise in glass‑through vias, redistribution layers (RDL) and module integration.

Micro LED draws attention in optical communications because, for short‑range (<10 m) links inside data‑center racks, it outperforms traditional laser sources that can only tolerate 75 °C and have failure rates 100 times higher than copper cables. Micro LED can endure up to 120 °C and boasts lifetimes exceeding 30,000 hours.

Moreover, Micro LED’s power draw is one‑tenth that of mainstream vertical‑cavity surface‑emitting lasers (VCSEL) and one‑fifth of silicon‑photonic solutions. It can reduce the power of a 1.6 Tbps optical transceiver from the conventional 30 W to roughly 1.6 W, easing cooling and operating costs in AI compute centers.

Industry analysts estimate that as transmission shifts from copper wiring to optical signals, the CPO module market will grow from $110 million in 2025 to $1.96 billion by 2033. Micro LED modules are expected to scale up in the second half of 2028, reaching a market value of about $848 million by 2030.

Taiwan’s LED camp, leveraging deep expertise in chip epitaxy, massive transfer and optoelectronic integration, is becoming a key driver for next‑generation optical‑communication technologies. Foxlink and Dingtian are teaming with AU Optronics to build system‑level optical modules; Foxlink focuses on ultra‑low‑power, 120 °C‑tolerant, long‑life Micro LED sources that have already cleared bandwidth limits for commercial standards.

Dingtian concentrates on gallium‑arsenide (GaAs) and indium‑gallium‑arsenide (InGaAs) photodiodes and miniature receiver components, and plans to spend NT$1.2 billion on clean‑room expansion to prepare for high‑end optical‑communication orders.

Micro LED maker NXP‑KY targets short‑range optical interconnects inside data‑center cabinets, using arrays of hundreds of micron‑scale LEDs to parallel‑transfer data and compensate for the speed of a single device. Leveraging low power, high tolerance to fiber‑incidence angles and low alignment cost, it is actively advancing fiber‑coupling technology, aiming to move from technical feasibility to commercial viability within two years.

Epitaxy specialist Guanghong is accelerating its transformation, moving away from the crowded traditional LED market. Its R&D program now includes Micro LED for optical communications, short‑wave infrared LEDs and VCSELs, extending existing chip‑level products into new wavelength bands to help build a complete Taiwanese roadmap for next‑generation optical‑transmission light sources.

items.title: 馬斯克AI算力狂飆！SpaceXAI今年增66萬顆輝達GB300 GPU、總數逼近144萬顆
items.title_en: Musk's AI Compute Soars! SpaceXAI Adds 660,000 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs This Year, Total Near 1.44 Million
paras: 馬斯克的人工智慧（AI）算力布局持續擴張。馬斯克近日在X平台公布，SpaceX(SPCX-US) 旗下AI事業SpaceXAI今年內將新增66萬顆輝達(NVDA-US) GB300 GPU，使GPU總持有量逼近144萬顆，甚至超過其兩年前提出的「百萬GPU」目標。
根據馬斯克公布的數據，SpaceXAI目前旗下Colossus 1配備15萬顆H100、5萬顆H200及3萬顆GB200；Colossus 2則配置11萬顆GB200及44萬顆GB300。
馬斯克表示，另有22萬顆GB300將於下周全面投入運作，另外22萬顆預計11月上線，若進度順利，12月底前還將再增加22萬顆GB300。
屆時，SpaceXAI的GB300總數將達110萬顆，GPU總持有量則達144萬顆。

Colossus 2全面採用Blackwell架構

隨著算力持續擴充，SpaceXAI在成立僅3年後，已建立大規模AI算力集群。相較之下，Anthropic成立約6年、OpenAI則成立約10年。
馬斯克透露，Colossus 1混用Hopper與Blackwell兩種架構，導致Grok模型訓練效率不佳，因此目前已出租給Anthropic執行推理任務。
至於Colossus 2則全面採用Blackwell架構，馬斯克表示，這樣的配置可避免訓練過程出現瓶頸。
不過，對SpaceXAI而言，持續取得GPU並非擴建資料中心面臨的最大限制，電力供應才是另一項關鍵問題。
SpaceXAI目前正建設一座1.2吉瓦（GW）的自有發電廠，為大規模AI算力集群提供電力。透過自建發電設施，公司可避開電網接入所需的長時間審批流程。
但這項做法也引發當地爭議。SpaceXAI因使用未取得許可的燃氣渦輪發電設備而面臨訴訟，並已承諾在一年內逐步拆除這些臨時發電設備，同時等待自有電廠完工啟用。

百萬GPU不是終點

大規模部署百萬顆GPU並非業界唯一案例。博通(AVGO-US) 2024年曾透露，旗下有3家超大規模客戶計劃在2027年前達成類似規模。
但對馬斯克而言，百萬顆GPU只是更大規模擴張的起點。他表示，SpaceXAI計劃在2027年將資料中心容量擴大7倍，並設定2030年達到5000萬顆H100等效GPU的長期目標。
SpaceXAI的算力布局也不局限於地面資料中心。SpaceX另計劃發射由100萬顆衛星組成的軌道資料中心系統，不過輝達執行長黃仁勳對此表示，目前仍只是「一個夢想」。
SpaceXAI快速擴大算力規模，顯示AI基礎設施競爭已不只是GPU採購的較量。從自建發電設施、出租既有算力，到規劃軌道資料中心，馬斯克正同步擴大在能源與資料中心基礎設施方面的布局。
paras_en: Musk's artificial intelligence (AI) compute strategy continues to expand. He recently announced on X that SpaceX (SPCX-US) subsidiary SpaceXAI will add 660,000 NVIDIA (NVDA-US) GB300 GPUs this year, bringing its total GPU holdings close to 1.44 million, even surpassing the "one‑million GPU" target he set two years ago.
According to Musk's data, SpaceXAI's Colossus 1 currently houses 150,000 H100s, 50,000 H200s and 30,000 GB200s, while Colossus 2 is equipped with 110,000 GB200s and 440,000 GB300s.
Musk said another 220,000 GB300 GPUs will go live next week, an additional 220,000 are slated for November, and, if everything stays on schedule, another 220,000 will be added by the end of December.
At that point, SpaceXAI will have 1.1 million GB300 GPUs and a total of 1.44 million GPUs overall.

Colossus 2 adopts the Blackwell architecture throughout. With compute capacity continuously expanding, SpaceXAI has built a massive AI compute cluster in just three years, compared with Anthropic’s roughly six‑year history and OpenAI’s about ten years.

Musk revealed that Colossus 1 mixes Hopper and Blackwell architectures, which has hampered training efficiency for the Grok model, so it is currently being leased to Anthropic for inference workloads.
By contrast, Colossus 2 uses the Blackwell architecture exclusively, which Musk says avoids bottlenecks during training.
However, for SpaceXAI the biggest hurdle isn’t acquiring more GPUs but securing power supply.
SpaceXAI is constructing a 1.2‑gigawatt (GW) private power plant to feed its massive AI compute cluster, allowing the company to bypass the lengthy approval process required for grid connections.

The approach has sparked local controversy: SpaceXAI faces lawsuits over unpermitted gas‑turbine generators and has pledged to dismantle the temporary units within a year while awaiting completion of its own plant.
A million GPUs is not the end point. Broadcom (AVGO-US) disclosed in 2024 that three of its ultra‑large customers aim to reach a similar scale by 2027.

For Musk, a million GPUs is just the start of a larger expansion. He says SpaceXAI plans to increase data‑center capacity seven‑fold by 2027 and targets the equivalent of 50 million H100 GPUs by 2030.

SpaceXAI’s compute strategy isn’t limited to ground‑based data centers. SpaceX also plans to launch an orbital data‑center system composed of one million satellites, though NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang calls the idea “still a dream” for now.

The rapid scaling of SpaceXAI’s compute power shows that AI infrastructure competition now goes beyond GPU procurement, encompassing private power generation, leasing existing compute, and even planning orbital data centers as Musk expands his footprint in energy and data‑center infrastructure.

items.title: 海外資金瘋搶美股！12個月淨買進9420億美元創40年新高、美債需求卻降溫
items.title_en: Overseas Funds Frenziedly Snap Up U.S. Stocks! Net Purchases of $942 B in 12 Months Hit 40‑Year High, Yet Demand for U.S. Treasuries Cools
paras: 海外資金正以前所未有的規模流入美國股市，但對美國債券的需求卻同步降溫，這項資金配置變化正在改變全球資本流動格局。
根據美國財政部數據，截至今年7月的過去12個月，海外投資人淨買進美國股票及投資基金9420億美元，創下自1985年有紀錄以來最高的12個月累計金額。
美國經濟分析局（BEA）數據顯示，今年第2季海外投資人淨買進美股及相關投資基金4260億美元，較2025年同期大增62%，也刷新2022年第2季創下的2990億美元單季紀錄。
相較之下，海外資金對美國債券的需求明顯降溫。今年第2季海外投資人淨買進美債1880億美元，低於第1季的3140億美元。

海外資金連續加碼美股　7月買盤明顯放緩

從月度數據來看，海外資金在第2季持續加碼美股，4月淨買進金額達1100億美元，6月進一步升至1820億美元。不過，7月買盤明顯放緩，淨買進金額降至37億美元，但海外投資人仍連續第6個月維持淨買進。
海外資金大舉流入之際，美股也維持強勁表現。截至7月的過去12個月，標普500指數上漲約20%，其中Sandisk、western digital及英特爾等科技股漲幅居前。
第2季標普500指數更大漲14.9%，儘管此前曾因伊朗戰爭爆發而出現劇烈跌勢，但跌勢並未持續，單季表現創下2020年第2季以來最佳紀錄。
美國對外關係委員會（Council on Foreign Relations）高級研究員Brad Setser表示，第2季海外資金買進金額異常放大，部分可能反映第1季較低買進量的延後效應，但更大的趨勢仍是海外投資人持續創紀錄買進美股。
Setser認為，南韓股市強勁上漲也是推動資金流動的重要因素之一。隨著三星、海力士等個股大幅走高，當地投資人觸及集中度限制後，被迫轉向美股等全球資產進行分散配置。
Setser指出，南韓出現超過2000億美元單向流向全球股市的資金，其中大部分流入美股，這種資金流動模式的改變，也與美元相關資產出現異常大量資金流入的情況相互呼應。

美股吸引海外資金　美債需求卻同步下滑

Setser也指出，海外資金流向美股的另一面，是在美國財政赤字持續擴大的情況下，海外投資人對美國國債的需求反而減弱，可能增加美國政府債務融資面臨的壓力。
Setser形容，目前市場呈現出海外投資人高度看好美股的情況。
對債券市場而言，資金配置從美國國債轉向股票，代表在美國持續大量發行債券之際，海外買盤的支撐有所減弱，美國政府可能需要依賴更多國內投資人承接債券供給，或面臨更高的融資成本。
paras_en: Overseas capital is flowing into the U.S. equity market on an unprecedented scale, but demand for U.S. bonds is cooling at the same time, a shift that is reshaping global capital flows.

According to U.S. Treasury data, overseas investors net‑bought $942 billion of U.S. stocks and investment funds in the 12‑month period ending July this year, the highest twelve‑month total on record since data began in 1985.

Data from the Bureau of Economic Analysis show that in Q2 overseas investors net‑bought $426 billion of U.S. equities and related funds, up 62% from the same quarter in 2025 and surpassing the single‑quarter record of $299 billion set in Q2 2022.
In contrast, demand for U.S. bonds by overseas capital has clearly cooled. In Q2 overseas investors net‑bought $188 billion of Treasuries, down from $314 billion in Q1.

Overseas money kept adding to U.S. equities in the second quarter, with net purchases of $110 billion in April and $182 billion in June. However, buying slowed sharply in July, with net inflows falling to $3.7 billion, though investors still posted net purchases for the sixth consecutive month.

While overseas capital surged in, U.S. stocks continued to perform strongly. Over the trailing twelve months to July, the S&P 500 rose about 20%, led by tech names such as SanDisk, Western Digital and Intel.

In Q2 the S&P 500 jumped 14.9%; although it had earlier suffered a sharp decline after the outbreak of the Iran war, the drop did not persist, and the quarter’s performance was the best since Q2 2020.

Brad Setser, senior fellow at the Council on Foreign Relations, said the Q2 surge in overseas buying was unusually large, partly reflecting a lagged effect from the lower Q1 purchases, but the broader trend is that foreign investors are continuously setting record levels of U.S. equity buying.

Setser added that the strong rally in South Korean equities also helped drive the flow, as soaring stocks such as Samsung and Hynix pushed local investors past concentration limits, forcing them to diversify into global assets like U.S. equities.

He noted that more than $200 billion of one‑way capital from South Korea has streamed into global stock markets, most of it into U.S. shares, a shift that mirrors the massive inflows into dollar‑denominated assets.

Setser also pointed out that while overseas money is pouring into U.S. stocks, the opposite is happening with Treasuries: as the U.S. fiscal deficit widens, foreign investors’ appetite for U.S. government debt is weakening, potentially raising financing pressure on the U.S. government.
Setser described the current market as one in which overseas investors are extremely bullish on U.S. equities.

For the bond market, the reallocation from U.S. Treasuries to stocks means that, even as the United States continues to issue large volumes of debt, foreign buying support is fading, forcing the government to rely more on domestic investors or face higher financing costs.

items.title: AI散熱需求催油門 12吋SiC發展加速 單晶、多晶、鍵合三路競逐
items.title_en: AI Cooling Demand Accelerates SiC Growth: 12‑inch SiC Development Speeds Up as Monocrystalline, Polycrystalline, and Bonded Paths Compete
paras: AI與HPC晶片功耗持續攀升，先進封裝散熱需求同步升溫，也讓過去主要應用在電動車、再生能源與功率半導體的碳化矽(SiC)，開始切入AI先進封裝新戰場。隨著應用版圖擴大，SiC產業也加速朝12吋大尺寸發展，包括Resonac、住友金屬礦山以及台廠盛新等業者近期接連宣布技術突破，單晶、鍵合與多晶SiC等不同技術路線同步升溫，12吋SiC路線戰正式開打。
Resonac日前宣布，已成功長出並加工12吋SiC單晶基板，為目前全球開發中的最大尺寸SiC基板之一。
Resonac此次特別點出新應用，如AI伺服器與HPC，單晶SiC相較傳統矽材料，具有高導熱特性，因此除了作為功率半導體材料，也開始被AI晶片的散熱應用所關注，有機會成為散熱基板及先進封裝使用，且因SiC具備高折射率特性，也具備切入AR智慧眼鏡等光學應用的潛力。
除了Resonac直接挑戰12吋單晶SiC，另一條技術路線則是透過「鍵合」降低昂貴單晶SiC的使用量。住友金屬礦山日前也宣布，成功開發12吋鍵合SiC基板，並已送樣給半導體廠，為全球首款12吋鍵合SiC基板，並預計將在近日登場的ICSCRM 2026展示。
業界指出，鍵合SiC的概念，是不再讓整片基板都使用高成本單晶SiC，而是在較便宜的支撐基板上，鍵合一層高品質、極薄的單晶SiC功能層，在保留單晶SiC電性與材料特性的同時，大幅降低單晶材料耗用量。
住友金屬曾表示，其SiC基板鍵合技術可透過直接鍵合方式，在維持單晶SiC特性的同時，達到低電阻、高強度等效果，目前6吋、8吋產品已可提供客戶使用。公司先前的鍵合SiC也已用於SiC MOSFET。
另外，中國業者泰坦未來則宣布推出12吋的多晶SiC基板，同樣鎖定AI先進封裝用的散熱基板等高溫散熱等領域。不過，業界認為，多晶SiC本身無法直接取代單晶SiC，而是透過扮演鍵合SiC的底層材料，切入高導熱、高溫製程等應用，因此隨著12吋鍵合SiC逐步發展，大尺寸多晶SiC的重要性也同步提高。
除了日本、中國業者，美國及台灣廠商也陸續投入，如美國龍頭Wolfspeed早在今年1月就已展示12吋單晶SiC技術，在當時被視為是突破技術的里程碑，盛新材料也在近日揭露12吋SiC晶球的開發成果，應用同樣以AI先進封裝與AR智慧眼鏡市場為主。
過去SiC主要成長動能來自電動車逆變器、充電樁與能源基礎建設，但隨著AI需求崛起，SiC迎來新市場，一方面，AI資料中心需要高效率電源轉換，持續拉升SiC功率元件需求；另一方面，GPU、ASIC等AI晶片功耗不斷增加，也讓高導熱SiC有機會進一步進入晶片散熱與先進封裝材料領域。
業界認為，12吋SiC隨著AI應用加入，業界競爭焦點正逐步轉向「低成本、大尺寸同時高品質且高導熱的SiC材料」，目前多家業者路線競爭升溫，成為百家爭鳴的新戰場。
paras_en: AI and HPC chip power consumption continues to rise, driving up the heat‑dissipation needs of advanced packaging. This has opened the door for silicon carbide (SiC)—previously dominated by electric‑vehicle, renewable‑energy and power‑semiconductor applications—to enter the AI advanced‑packaging arena. As the application scope expands, the SiC industry is accelerating toward 12‑inch wafer sizes, with recent breakthroughs announced by Resonac, Sumitomo Metal Mining and Taiwan’s Sheng‑Xin. Monocrystalline, bonded and polycrystalline SiC technologies are all heating up, officially launching the 12‑inch SiC race.
Resonac recently announced that it has successfully grown and processed a 12‑inch monocrystalline SiC wafer, one of the largest SiC substrates under development worldwide.

Resonac highlighted new applications such as AI servers and HPC. Compared with traditional silicon, monocrystalline SiC offers high thermal conductivity, making it attractive not only as a power‑semiconductor material but also for AI chip cooling. It could serve as a heat‑spreading substrate and in advanced packaging, and its high refractive index gives it potential for optical uses such as AR smart glasses.

In addition to Resonac’s direct challenge with 12‑inch monocrystalline SiC, another route reduces the amount of expensive monocrystalline SiC by using “bonded” wafers. Sumitomo Metal Mining recently announced the successful development of a 12‑inch bonded SiC substrate, which has already been sent to semiconductor customers. It is the world’s first 12‑inch bonded SiC wafer and is slated for display at the upcoming ICSCRM 2026 conference.

Industry observers explain that bonded SiC works by attaching a thin, high‑quality monocrystalline SiC functional layer onto a cheaper supporting substrate. This retains the electrical and material advantages of monocrystalline SiC while dramatically cutting the consumption of the costly single‑crystal material.

Sumitomo Metal has said its SiC bonding technology can achieve low resistance and high strength while preserving monocrystalline SiC characteristics through direct bonding. Products in 6‑inch and 8‑inch sizes are already available to customers, and the company’s bonded SiC has previously been used in SiC MOSFETs.

Meanwhile, China’s Titan Future announced a 12‑inch polycrystalline SiC wafer aimed at high‑temperature cooling substrates for AI advanced packaging. However, the industry notes that polycrystalline SiC cannot directly replace monocrystalline SiC; instead, it serves as the base material for bonded SiC, enabling high‑thermal‑conductivity, high‑temperature processes. As bonded 12‑inch SiC matures, the importance of large‑size polycrystalline SiC rises in tandem.

Beyond Japanese and Chinese players, U.S. and Taiwanese firms are also joining the race. U.S. leader Wolfspeed showcased its 12‑inch monocrystalline SiC technology in January, hailed as a milestone breakthrough, while Taiwan’s Sheng‑Xin Materials recently revealed progress on 12‑inch SiC crystal balls, targeting AI advanced packaging and AR smart‑glass markets.

Historically, SiC growth has been driven by electric‑vehicle inverters, charging stations and energy infrastructure. With the surge in AI demand, SiC is entering a new market: AI data centers need highly efficient power conversion, boosting demand for SiC power devices, while the rising power draw of GPUs, ASICs and other AI chips creates opportunities for high‑thermal‑conductivity SiC in chip cooling and advanced‑packaging materials.

Industry insiders believe that as AI applications adopt 12‑inch SiC, competition is shifting toward “low‑cost, large‑size, high‑quality, high‑thermal‑conductivity” SiC materials. Multiple companies are intensifying their respective routes, turning the sector into a bustling battlefield of innovation.

items.title: 微軟發布AI使用報告 台灣AI使用率33.8%全球排名前進至第19
items.title_en: Microsoft Releases AI Usage Report; Taiwan AI Usage Rate 33.8% Rises to 19th Globally
paras: 微軟(MSFT-US)發布全球AI使用報告，全球第二季AI使用率為18.8%，季增1個百分點，其中，台灣第二季AI使用率為33.8%，季增2個百分點，全球排名從20名提升至19名。
微軟指出，AI普及率(AI diffusion)為統計期間內，全球15至64歲人口中，曾經使用生成式AI產品的比例。根據報告，第二季全球AI使用率持續攀升，全球勞動年齡人口中，使用AI的比例達18.8%，較第一季高出1個百分點，且幾乎所有的經濟體AI使用量皆有所提升。
全球AI使用率最高的國家為阿拉伯聯合大公國，使用率達73.3%；其次為新加坡，使用率64.3%；第三名為愛爾蘭，使用率49.9%；第四名為法國，使用率49.6%；第五名為挪威，使用率49.4%。
值得注意的是，南韓第二季AI使用率為40.6%，較第一季提升3.5個百分點，再度成為AI使用率絕對增幅最大的經濟體；沙烏地阿拉伯排名從30名提升至25名，排名增幅最大；日本則是相對增幅最大，AI使用率季增2.2個百分點，相較於第一季約成長10%。
另外，開放權重模型(Open-weight models)正在快速崛起，並擴大AI應用範圍。微軟指出，開放權重模型會釋出訓練後的模型權重，開發者或組織可以自行下載、修改，相較於只能透過專有服務使用的封閉模型，具有更高的部署與客製化自由度。
微軟進一步提到，開放權重的使用狀況，可能無法捕捉一般消費者端的AI使用率的使用全貌，因此API的使用可作為觀察AI普及程度的角度。針對開放權重模型的使用情況，根據OpenRouter公開資料，開放權重模型已占OpenRouter token使用量約75%。
整體而言，微軟認為，雖這些數據不能代表全球市場占有率，但開放權重模型成為以API為基礎的AI經濟中愈來愈重義的一環，市場也愈來愈廣泛採用開放權重模型。
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) released a global AI usage report showing that the worldwide AI usage rate for Q2 was 18.8%, up one percentage point quarter‑over‑quarter. Taiwan’s AI usage rate for Q2 was 33.8%, up two percentage points, moving the country from 20th to 19th place globally.

Microsoft defined AI diffusion as the proportion of the global population aged 15‑64 who have ever used a generative AI product during the measurement period. The report indicates that the global AI usage rate continued to climb in Q2, reaching 18.8% of the working‑age population, a one‑point increase from Q1, with almost every economy showing higher AI usage.
The highest AI usage rates were recorded in the United Arab Emirates at 73.3%, followed by Singapore at 64.3%, Ireland at 49.9%, France at 49.6% and Norway at 49.4%.

Notably, South Korea’s Q2 AI usage rate was 40.6%, a 3.5‑point rise from Q1, making it the economy with the largest absolute increase; Saudi Arabia jumped from 30th to 25th place, the biggest ranking gain; Japan posted the largest relative gain, with a 2.2‑point quarterly increase, roughly a 10% rise from Q1.

In addition, open‑weight models are rapidly emerging and expanding the scope of AI applications. Microsoft explained that open‑weight models release the trained model weights, allowing developers or organizations to download and modify them, offering greater deployment and customization flexibility compared with closed models that can only be accessed via proprietary services.

Microsoft added that usage of open‑weight models may not fully capture consumer‑side AI usage, so API usage can serve as an indicator of AI diffusion. According to publicly available OpenRouter data, open‑weight models now account for about 75% of OpenRouter token usage.

Overall, Microsoft believes that while these figures do not represent global market share, open‑weight models are becoming an increasingly important component of the API‑driven AI economy, and the market is adopting open‑weight models more broadly.

items.title: 美銀警告美股恐迎一波猛烈拋售！「兩大訊號」值得警惕
items.title_en: Bank of America Warns US Stocks May Face a Wave of Fierce Selling! Two Signals Worth Heeding
paras: 美國銀行表示，債券市場焦慮情緒的升溫，加上金融股遭到拋售，可能代表股市將遭受一場嚴重衝擊。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，美國銀行分析師Michael Hartnett領軍的團隊週五（25日）發布《Flow Show》報告指出，衡量美國公債市場預期波動程度的MOVE指數，過去近日短短兩天飆升33%。
MOVE指數與衡量股市波動的VIX指數類似，通常會在美國公債市場出現劇烈波動時攀升。本週，投資人因通膨疑慮及聯準會（Fed）可能加快升息步調而拋售債券，帶動10年期美國公債殖利率升至19年高點。
Hartnett表示，作為全球借貸市場的重要基準，公債市場波動率如此快速攀升對金融市場並非好事。若MOVE指數持續走高，同時安碩標普全球金融指數基金(IXG-US) 大幅下跌，股市恐面臨更大的風險。
他指出，若安碩標普全球金融指數基金跌破125美元、MOVE指數升破125，股市將出現「避險式去槓桿事件」。目前安碩標普全球金融指數基金報130.21美元，MOVE指數則為96.00。
Hartnett進一步警告，若美國與伊朗達成協議，使油價再下跌10美元，但美國公債殖利率仍持續攀升，股市將面臨更大的避險風險。
不過，Hartnett表示，屆時政策制定者將出現「恐慌」，並採取措施壓低油價與債券殖利率。
分析指出，Hartnett似乎認為，任何以固定收益市場為重點的政策，其力度都將超過目前美國財政部試圖透過增加長天期公債購買量來壓低基準殖利率、但成效不彰的計畫。
若政策干預最終壓低殖利率，Hartnett建議投資人可開始少量布局債券。他估算，若未來12個月殖利率下降100個基點，5年期美債價格可能上漲10%、10年期美債上漲14%，30年期美債則可能上漲22%。
Hartnett總結表示，「當政策制定者開始恐慌時，市場就會停止恐慌」，而任何壓低油價與債券殖利率的政策干預，也將對美元形成負面影響，但有利於大宗商品及新興市場資產。
paras_en: Bank of America said that rising anxiety in the bond market, combined with a sell‑off in financial stocks, could signal a severe shock to the equity market.

According to MarketWatch, a team led by Bank of America analyst Michael Hartnett released a “Flow Show” report on Friday (the 25th) noting that the MOVE index, which measures expected volatility in the US Treasury market, surged 33% in just two days.

The MOVE index, similar to the VIX that gauges equity market volatility, typically climbs when the Treasury market experiences sharp swings. This week, investors sold bonds over inflation concerns and the prospect that the Fed might accelerate rate hikes, pushing the 10‑year Treasury yield to its highest level since 2019.

Hartnett said that as a key benchmark for global lending markets, such a rapid rise in Treasury volatility is not good for financial markets. If the MOVE index keeps climbing while the iShares S&P Global Financial Index Fund (IXG‑US) falls sharply, the stock market could face greater risk.

He noted that if the iShares S&P Global Financial Index Fund drops below $125 and the MOVE index climbs above 125, the market could experience a “hedge‑driven deleveraging event.” The fund is currently at $130.21 and the MOVE index stands at 96.00.
Hartnett further warned that if the US reaches an agreement with Iran that drives oil prices down another $10, but Treasury yields keep rising, the equity market would face heightened hedge‑risk.
However, Hartnett said policymakers would then panic and take steps to push oil prices and bond yields lower.

The analysis suggests Hartnett believes any policy focused on the fixed‑income market would be more forceful than the current US Treasury’s attempt to lower benchmark yields by increasing long‑term Treasury purchases, a plan that has so far shown limited results.

If policy intervention ultimately brings yields down, Hartnett recommends investors start modestly building bond positions. He estimates that if yields fall by 100 basis points over the next 12 months, 5‑year Treasury prices could rise 10%, 10‑year Treasuries 14%, and 30‑year Treasuries 22%.

Hartnett concluded, “When policymakers start to panic, the market stops panicking,” and any intervention to lower oil prices and Treasury yields would negatively affect the dollar but benefit commodities and emerging‑market assets.

items.title: 波克夏持續加碼「這一股」！持股升至11%、斥資21億美元布局美國房市
items.title_en: Berkshire Continues to Increase Stake in "This Stock"! Holding Rises to 11% with $2.1 Billion Invested in U.S. Housing Market
paras: 波克夏(B)(BRK.B-US) 持續加碼美國第二大房屋建商萊納房屋(LEN-US、LEN.B-US) ，近期再買進近170萬股，使持股比重升至約11%，持有股票市值約21億美元。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，波克夏週五（25日）美股收盤後向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）提交的Form 4文件顯示，波克夏在週三至週五期間買進近170萬股萊納房屋股票，平均每股價格約81美元。目前波克夏持有萊納房屋近2600萬股。
波克夏在9月17日至21日期間也買進260萬股萊納房屋，持股比率因此突破10%門檻，依法必須在2個交易日內申報後續交易。
自第2季底以來，波克夏持有的萊納房屋股份幾乎增加1倍。
波克夏似乎正在趁萊納房屋股價低迷之際加碼。萊納房屋週五股價上漲0.8%至82.15美元，但今年以來仍下跌約20%，在主要美國房屋建商中表現相對疲弱。
萊納房屋目前股價低於每股約90美元的帳面價值，在房市低迷之際，成為市場關注的價值型標的。
萊納房屋獲利受到房市疲弱拖累，尤其是公司業務占比不低的入門級住宅市場。萊納房屋截至8月的季度平均房屋售價約37.2萬美元。
萊納房屋在截至8月的第3季中每股獲利下滑近50%，至1.19美元。市場預估，萊納房屋本會計年度每股獲利約5美元，低於2025會計年度的約8美元，以及2024會計年度的14美元。
萊納房屋的獲利率在同業中也相對偏低。以房屋建造營收計算，萊納房屋規模僅次於D.R. Horton(DHI-US) ；若以市值計算，則排名第3，落後D.R. Horton及普得集團(PHM-US) ，目前市值約200億美元。
分析認為，此次波克夏加碼萊納房屋的交易，可能由投資經理Ted Weschler主導。Weschler負責波克夏約3500億美元股票投資組合中的約6%，並向執行長阿貝爾（Greg Abel）回報。
波克夏近期也持續布局房屋建築產業。今年7月，波克夏以約80億美元收購中型房屋建商Taylor Morrison；此外，波克夏旗下也擁有美國製造住宅市場龍頭Clayton Homes。
萊納房屋先前也曾受到《巴隆》看好，該媒體曾認為萊納房屋可能成為波克夏的收購標的。不過，若波克夏進一步尋求收購萊納房屋，仍需取得執行長Stuart Miller同意。
Miller透過持有萊納房屋多數具超級投票權的B類股掌握公司控制權。Miller家族長期控制這家成立於1950年代、總部位於邁阿密的房屋建商。
截至目前，波克夏持有萊納房屋約2540萬股A類股，以及逾50萬股流動性較低的B類股；B類股交易價格略低於A類股。
paras_en: Berkshire (B)(BRK.B-US) keeps adding to its position in the United States' second‑largest homebuilder Lennar (LEN-US, LEN.B-US), recently buying about 1.7 million shares and lifting its ownership to roughly 11%, with a market value of about $2.1 billion.

According to Barron's, a Form 4 filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission after the market close on Friday (the 25th) shows Berkshire bought nearly 1.7 million Lennar shares between Wednesday and Friday at an average price of about $81 per share. Berkshire now holds close to 26 million Lennar shares.

Berkshire also bought 2.6 million Lennar shares between September 17 and 21, pushing its stake past the 10% threshold, which under the law requires a filing of subsequent trades within two trading days.
Since the end of Q2, Berkshire’s Lennar holdings have almost doubled.

Berkshire appears to be taking advantage of Lennar’s depressed share price. Lennar’s stock rose 0.8% on Friday to $82.15, but it is still down about 20% year‑to‑date, making it one of the weaker performers among major U.S. homebuilders.
Lennar’s current price is below its book value of roughly $90 per share, positioning it as a value‑oriented target amid a sluggish housing market.

Lennar’s earnings have been dragged down by a weak housing market, especially in the entry‑level segment that makes up a sizable share of its business. The average home price for the quarter ending August was about $372,000.

In the third quarter ending August, Lennar’s earnings per share fell nearly 50% to $1.19. Analysts project EPS of about $5 for the current fiscal year, down from roughly $8 for FY 2025 and $14 for FY 2024.

Lennar’s profit margin is low relative to peers. By construction‑revenue size it ranks just behind D.R. Horton (DHI‑US); by market capitalization it is third, trailing D.R. Horton and Pulte Group (PHM‑US), with a market value of about $20 billion.

Analysts think the latest Berkshire purchase of Lennar was likely led by investment manager Ted Weschler, who oversees roughly 6% of Berkshire’s roughly $350 billion equity portfolio and reports to CEO Greg Abel.

Berkshire has been actively building a presence in home construction. In July it spent about $8 billion to acquire mid‑size builder Taylor Morrison, and it already owns Clayton Homes, the leading U.S. manufactured‑home company.

Lennar has previously been favored by Barron’s, which once suggested it could become a Berkshire acquisition target. However, any further move toward a takeover would still need the consent of CEO Stuart Miller.
Miller controls the company through his ownership of the majority of super‑voting B‑class shares. The Miller family has long held sway over the Miami‑based builder, which was founded in the 1950s.
To date Berkshire holds roughly 25.4 million Lennar Class A shares and more than 500,000 lower‑liquidity Class B shares, with the B shares trading at a slight discount to the A shares.

items.title: 邁威爾：光學互連、記憶體成AI下一階段算力擴張關鍵
items.title_en: Marvell: Optical Interconnects and Memory Are Key to the Next Phase of AI Compute Expansion
paras: 人工智慧（AI）算力競賽正逐漸從晶片效能比拚，擴大至互連、記憶體與網路等整體基礎設施的競爭。邁威爾科技(MRVL-US) 高層近日在Six Five Summit 2026指出，隨著推論模型帶動記憶體需求快速攀升，加上資料中心規模持續擴大，傳統銅基互連逐漸接近效能極限，光學互連與記憶體擴充技術將成為下一階段AI算力擴張的重要因素。
邁威爾客製化雲端解決方案業務執行副總裁Will Chu表示，市場長期將注意力集中在XPU本身，但XPU周邊的「附著層」同樣關鍵，涵蓋網路、記憶體、儲存及安全等領域。
他指出，每顆XPU背後都存在3至4個甚至更多的客製化機會，反映AI基礎設施正全面走向客製化。
邁威爾資料中心網路業務集團執行副總裁Dave Lazovsky則表示，推論時運算（inference time compute）興起，使KV快取需求在過去9個月增加約10倍，單一機架已難以提供足夠記憶體容量，規模化部署因此必須擴展至更大的互連範圍。
AI基礎設施需求持續擴張，也將帶動相關供應鏈迎來長期需求，包括記憶體、光學互連及客製化晶片設計等業者。
分析機構估計，2025年至2030年間，全球資料中心基礎設施累計資本支出規模可能達4兆至5兆美元。

銅連接接近極限　光學互連成擴充關鍵

Lazovsky將AI基礎設施由銅轉向光學互連形容為「強制函數」，而非可選的升級方案。
他指出，早期大型基礎模型已建立龐大的總記憶體需求，隨著推論模型發展及KV快取快速增加，單一機架中的HBM容量已不足以支撐尖端模型運作。
他表示，AI系統必須將互連規模由目前約144個XPU擴大至下一階段約576個XPU的Pod，並持續向更大規模擴展，而這也代表互連技術必須從銅基方案轉向光學方案。
邁威爾目前同步推進板載光學（NPO）及共封裝光學（CPO）兩條技術路線，並已在乙太網路及UAL協議交換器上導入CPO方案。
Chu指出，邁威爾可協助客戶從傳統銅連接方案逐步轉向NPO及CPO，客製化範圍則可從運算單元、I/O介面一路延伸至交換器連接埠。
Lazovsky也強調邁威爾類比SerDes技術的差異化。他表示，相較於傳統2.4T SerDes光學鏈路，採用類比SerDes的Scale Up網路可將功耗降低約4倍，全面部署後預計可使資料中心整體能耗降低逾25%。

AI記憶體需求暴增　CXL、3D堆疊及光子技術成解方

Chu將記憶體瓶頸視為AI基礎設施目前面臨的核心工程挑戰，邁威爾的布局則涵蓋晶片內外不同層級。
在晶片內部，邁威爾正投入專有高密度SRAM IP，透過與運算單元緊密整合提升效能，並支援更大型模型在晶片上的運作。Chu指出，傳統通用記憶體編譯方案已難以滿足客戶需求。
晶片外部則涵蓋多種技術，包括整合客製化HBM以提升頻寬與容量、透過3D堆疊將記憶體直接置於邏輯晶片上，以及利用CXL或專有協議進行記憶體擴充，以容量換取頻寬。
此外，邁威爾也推出光子織物記憶體（Photonic Fabric Memory）設備，可在獨立機架空間內提供32TB外接記憶體池。
Lazovsky指出，該光子織物記憶體系統結合DDR的容量與成本優勢，以及HBM的高頻寬與多偽通道平行特性，目標是讓記憶體容量與頻寬能夠獨立擴充，降低對運算資源的綁定。
Chu另表示，記憶體價格持續高漲，也促使超大規模雲端業者重新檢視整體基礎設施架構。邁威爾的CXL產品已獲得需求，部分客戶希望將舊有記憶體導入新伺服器，並透過記憶體壓縮讓等效容量增加1倍。
此外，部分業者也開始關注Flash層級的記憶體分層方案，作為成本較低的容量補充選項。

規模擴展網路走向客製化　XPU與網路深度整合

Lazovsky指出，目前約4家公司占據資料中心基礎設施整體可服務市場（TAM）75%以上。市場高度集中，也讓邁威爾得以與主要客戶的開發團隊深度合作，提前數年共同規畫下一代交換器架構。
他表示，目前規模擴展網路（Scale Up Network）主要存在3種路線：部分業者採用乙太網路方案；另一條路線採用UAL協議，屬於類似NVLink、基於記憶體語義載入與儲存的高效能網路；另有業者則採用完全自行開發的專有拓撲網路。
Chu指出，XPU與規模擴展網路之間高度緊密的整合，將推動協議層及最佳化策略進一步客製化，最終形成客製化晶片。
他表示，並非所有業者都具備端到端開發能力，而邁威爾除了能提供相關能力，也能作為客戶開發團隊的延伸，直接參與核心基礎設施設計。
Lazovsky則表示，邁威爾與主要超大規模雲端業者及GPU製造商建立的長期合作關係，是公司的重要資產，這類信任需要多年累積。
paras_en: The AI compute race is shifting from pure chip performance to a broader competition over interconnects, memory, and networking infrastructure. Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) executives said at Six Five Summit 2026 that as inference models drive a rapid rise in memory demand and data‑center sizes keep growing, traditional copper interconnects are approaching their performance limits, making optical interconnects and memory‑expansion technologies critical for the next wave of AI compute growth.

Will Chu, Marvell’s Vice President of Cloud‑Solutions Business Execution, noted that the market has long focused on the XPU itself, but the surrounding “attachment layer” – encompassing networking, memory, storage and security – is equally crucial.
He explained that each XPU can involve three to four or more customisation opportunities, reflecting a move toward fully customised AI infrastructure.

Dave Lazovsky, Executive Vice President of Marvell’s Data‑Center Networking Business Group, said the rise of inference‑time compute has caused KV‑cache demand to jump roughly ten‑fold over the past nine months, making a single rack insufficient for memory capacity and forcing deployments to scale to larger interconnect domains.
The expanding demand for AI infrastructure will also drive long‑term demand across the supply chain, including memory, optical interconnects and custom chip design firms.
Analysts estimate that global data‑center infrastructure capital expenditures could total $4‑5 trillion between 2025 and 2030.
Copper connections are nearing their limits; optical interconnects become the expansion key. Lazovsky described the shift from copper to optical as a “forced function,” not an optional upgrade.

He noted that early large foundation models already created massive total memory needs, and as inference models evolve and KV‑cache grows quickly, the HBM capacity in a single rack can no longer support cutting‑edge models.

He said AI systems must expand interconnect scale from roughly 144 XPUs today to about 576 XPUs per pod in the next phase, and continue scaling larger, which requires moving from copper‑based to optical interconnect solutions.
Marvell is simultaneously advancing two technology paths – on‑board optics (NPO) and co‑packaged optics (CPO) – and has already deployed CPO in Ethernet and UAL protocol switches.
Chu said Marvell can help customers transition from traditional copper connections to NPO and CPO, with customisation extending from compute units and I/O interfaces all the way to switch ports.

Lazovsky highlighted Marvell’s analog‑SerDes differentiation. Compared with conventional 2.4 Tb/s SerDes optical links, the analog‑SerDes Scale‑Up network can cut power consumption by about four‑fold, and full deployment is expected to reduce overall data‑center energy use by more than 25%.

AI memory demand is exploding; CXL, 3D stacking and photonic technologies are the solutions. Chu sees the memory bottleneck as the core engineering challenge for AI infrastructure, and Marvell’s strategy spans multiple chip‑level layers.

Inside the chip, Marvell is investing in proprietary high‑density SRAM IP tightly integrated with compute units to boost performance and support larger models on‑chip. Chu said traditional generic memory compilation approaches can no longer meet customer needs.

Outside the chip, Marvell’s portfolio includes custom HBM for higher bandwidth and capacity, 3D‑stacked memory placed directly on logic dies, and memory expansion via CXL or proprietary protocols that trade capacity for bandwidth.
Marvell also introduced a Photonic Fabric Memory device that can provide a 32 TB external memory pool within a standalone rack space.

Lazovsky explained that this photonic fabric memory combines DDR’s capacity and cost advantages with HBM’s high bandwidth and multi‑lane parallelism, aiming to let capacity and bandwidth scale independently and reduce dependence on compute resources.

Chu added that rising memory prices are prompting hyperscale cloud providers to re‑examine overall infrastructure architecture. Marvell’s CXL products have seen demand, with some customers wanting to retrofit legacy memory into new servers and use memory compression to double effective capacity.
Additionally, some vendors are looking at flash‑level memory tiering as a lower‑cost capacity supplement.

Network scaling is moving toward customisation, with deep XPU‑network integration. Lazovsky noted that about four companies now control over 75 % of the total addressable market for data‑center infrastructure, a concentration that allows Marvell to work closely with major customers’ development teams to co‑design next‑generation switch architectures years in advance.

He said there are three main paths for Scale‑Up Networks today: some vendors use Ethernet solutions; another path uses the UAL protocol, a high‑performance network similar to NVLink that leverages memory‑semantic load/store; and a third group builds fully proprietary topologies.
Chu said the tight integration of XPUs with Scale‑Up Networks will drive further customisation of protocol layers and optimisation strategies, ultimately resulting in custom chips.

He noted that not all vendors have end‑to‑end development capabilities, and Marvell can both provide those capabilities and act as an extension of customers’ development teams, directly participating in core infrastructure design.
Lazovsky concluded that Marvell’s long‑term partnerships with major hyperscale cloud providers and GPU makers are a key asset for the company, and such trust is built up over many years.

items.title: AI代理對決美債殖利率！誰將主導美股？高盛：多頭可「這樣」避險
items.title_en: AI Agents vs U.S. Treasury Yields: Who Will Lead the U.S. Stock Market? Goldman Sachs: Bullish Positions Can Hedge This Way
paras: 人工智慧代理（AI Agent）熱潮與美國公債殖利率上升正同時牽動美股，市場表現呈現明顯分化。一方面，Meta(META-US) 推出AI代理模型Muse，帶動公司單週市值增加2200億美元，推升那斯達克100指數成為本週表現最強的主要股指；另一方面，美債殖利率持續走高，令對利率敏感的資產承壓，羅素2000指數明顯落後大盤，標普500指數則在7700點附近反覆震盪。
市場內部分化程度也進一步擴大。若排除AI相關股票，標普500本週實際下跌約1%；紐約證券交易所創下新低的股票數量則連續9個交易日超過創新高股票，創下2023年10月以來最長紀錄。
高盛全球避險基金業務負責人Tony Pasquariello將目前股市與利率市場的拉鋸形容為「令人沮喪的貓鼠遊戲」，並表示若投資人維持股票多頭部位，可同步放空美國公債，以降低利率上升帶來的風險。

Meta推出Muse AI 代理行情升溫

Meta推出Muse成為本週市場的重要催化劑。這款AI代理產品發布後，Meta單週市值增加2200億美元，總市值重新站上2兆美元，也帶動AI相關產業走強。
其中，半導體類股受到「推理經濟」可能增加硬體需求的預期支撐，AI代理相關股票同步受益。高盛旗下AI代理籃子指數走高，高貝塔動能籃子則連續9個交易日上漲。
高盛資深交易員Rich Privorotsky表示，Muse只是眾多AI 代理產品中的第一個，未來數週及數月內，Google與OpenAI的競品也可能陸續出現。
他認為，隨著大型企業承擔安全、基礎設施及分發等功能，部分經濟活動中的摩擦與中間環節將減少，形成生產力提升，並在結構上具有抑制通膨的效果，對整體股市的綜合影響偏正面。
與此同時，美股市值集中程度已升至高位。高盛首席科技分析師Pete Callahan指出，目前標普500指數中，市值超過1兆美元的美國TMT企業已有10家，3年前AI週期啟動時則僅有3家。

AI行情強勢 市場廣度卻持續惡化

AI股票上漲的另一面，是整體市場廣度明顯轉弱。本週科技類股表現突出，能源與金融類股則相對落後；「科技七巨頭」的漲幅幾乎是標普500其餘493檔成分股的3倍。
紐約證券交易所創新低股票數量連續9個交易日高於創新高股票，顯示市場上漲主要集中在少數大型科技股，「擴散交易」已明顯降溫。
AI產業內部也開始出現差異。AI電力相關股票本週表現疲弱，其走勢與美國期中選舉中民主黨贏得眾議院的機率呈高度反向關聯，反映市場對政策變化可能影響資料中心建設的擔憂。
此外，超大規模雲端業者的信用利差本週明顯擴大，但相關股票估值仍處高位。高盛指出，超大規模雲端業者信用風險與那斯達克隱含波動率之間的背離已擴大至異常程度。

美債殖利率攀升 標普500突破7700點受阻

美債殖利率持續上升，成為本週壓抑股市進一步突破的重要因素。標普500指數在7700點附近盤整約兩個月，週二一度出現突破跡象，但隨後受到債市走勢影響回落。
Pasquariello指出，每當股市試圖向上突破，利率就同步走高，進而壓抑市場風險偏好；利率上升也會透過金融條件收緊，直接打擊對利率較敏感的資產。
羅素2000指數已連續6週落後標普500，高盛表示，小型股持續受到長線基金及財富管理管道賣壓影響，技術面也出現轉弱。
不過，AI基礎建設股票的部分悲觀預期已反映在估值中。高盛美國股票策略團隊研究顯示，AI基礎建設股票的中位數遠期本益比，已從2026年4月的32倍降至目前的22倍。

高盛：股票多頭可搭配美債空頭避險

面對股市與利率市場的拉鋸，Pasquariello提出，如果投資人持有較大股票多頭部位，可搭配建立美債空頭部位，以對沖殖利率上升風險。
他以-10至+10的標準衡量市場投機性多頭部位，目前評估為+3，顯示整體倉位並不擁擠。
他同時指出，股票回購力度正在放緩，新股發行規模增加，美國散戶投資人也趨於觀望，使目前市場結構仍存在一些不利因素。
不過，在近期利率快速上升的背景下，美股仍能維持大部分漲幅，顯示市場仍具有一定韌性。
Pasquariello認為，若市場出現足以推動股市突破的催化劑，短線資金可能迅速進場追漲；在此之前，股市與利率之間的拉鋸仍可能持續。
paras_en: The surge of AI agents and the rise in U.S. Treasury yields are simultaneously pulling the U.S. stock market in different directions, creating a clear split in market performance. On one hand, Meta (META‑US) launched its AI agent model Muse, boosting the company’s weekly market value by $220 billion and propelling the Nasdaq 100 to become the strongest performing major index this week; on the other hand, Treasury yields have continued to climb, pressuring rate‑sensitive assets, with the Russell 2000 lagging noticeably behind the broader market and the S&P 500 oscillating around 7,700 points.

Market fragmentation has widened further. Excluding AI‑related stocks, the S&P 500 actually fell about 1% this week, while the number of stocks hitting new lows on the New York Stock Exchange has exceeded the number of new highs for nine consecutive trading days, setting the longest streak since October 2023.

Goldman Sachs Global Hedge Fund business head Tony Pasquariello described the tug‑of‑war between the equity and rate markets as a "frustrating cat‑and‑mouse game," and said that if investors maintain bullish equity positions, they can simultaneously short U.S. Treasuries to reduce the risk from rising rates.

Meta’s Muse AI agent launch has become a key catalyst for the market this week. After its release, Meta’s weekly market value rose by $220 billion, bringing its total market cap back above $2 trillion and strengthening AI‑related industries.

Semiconductor stocks benefited from expectations that "inference economics" could increase hardware demand, and AI‑agent‑related stocks also gained. Goldman’s AI‑agent basket index rose, while the high‑beta momentum basket climbed for nine consecutive trading days.
Goldman senior trader Rich Privorotsky said Muse is just the first of many AI agents, and that competitors from Google and OpenAI may appear in the coming weeks and months.

He believes that as large enterprises take on security, infrastructure, and distribution functions, friction and intermediaries in some economic activities will decrease, boosting productivity and structurally dampening inflation, which has a net positive impact on the overall equity market.

Meanwhile, U.S. market concentration has risen to high levels. Goldman chief technology analyst Pete Callahan noted that there are now ten U.S. TMT companies in the S&P 500 with market caps over $1 trillion, compared to only three when the AI cycle began three years ago.

AI stocks are rising, but market breadth is deteriorating. Tech stocks performed strongly this week, while energy and financials lagged; the gains of the "Tech Seven Giants" were almost three times those of the remaining 493 S&P 500 constituents.

The number of NYSE stocks hitting new lows has exceeded new highs for nine consecutive trading days, indicating that market gains are concentrated in a few large tech stocks and that "diffusion trading" has cooled.

Within the AI industry, differences are emerging. AI‑power‑related stocks performed poorly this week, and their performance is highly inversely correlated with the probability of the Democratic Party winning the U.S. midterm House elections, reflecting concerns that policy changes could affect data‑center construction.

Additionally, the credit spreads of mega‑cloud providers widened significantly this week, but their valuations remain high. Goldman noted that the divergence between mega‑cloud credit risk and Nasdaq implied volatility has expanded to abnormal levels.

U.S. Treasury yields are climbing, hindering the S&P 500 from breaking through 7,700 points. The index has been consolidating around 7,700 for about two months; on Tuesday it briefly showed breakout signs but then retreated due to bond market movements.

Pasquariello pointed out that whenever the market attempts to break higher, rates rise simultaneously, suppressing risk appetite; rising rates also tighten financial conditions and directly hit rate‑sensitive assets.

The Russell 2000 has lagged the S&P 500 for six consecutive weeks. Goldman says small stocks continue to suffer from long‑term fund and wealth‑management channel selling pressure, and technicals have weakened.

However, some pessimistic expectations for AI infrastructure stocks are already reflected in valuations. Goldman’s U.S. equity strategy team found that the median forward P/E for AI infrastructure stocks fell from 32× in April 2026 to 22× today.

Goldman: Bullish equity positions can be paired with Treasury shorts for hedging. Facing the tug‑of‑war between equities and rates, Pasquariello suggested that investors with sizable bullish equity positions can pair them with Treasury shorts to hedge rising yield risk.
He measured market speculation using a -10 to +10 scale, currently rating it at +3, indicating that overall positions are not overly crowded.
He also noted that share‑repurchase momentum is slowing, new‑issue volumes are rising, and U.S. retail investors are becoming more cautious, leaving some adverse structural factors in the market.
Nevertheless, amid the recent rapid rise in rates, U.S. equities have maintained most of their gains, showing some resilience.

Pasquariello believes that if a catalyst strong enough to push the market higher emerges, short‑term capital may quickly enter to chase gains; until then, the tug‑of‑war between equities and rates may continue.

items.title: 馬斯克AI算力狂飆！SpaceXAI今年增66萬顆輝達GB300 GPU、總數逼近144萬顆
items.title_en: Musk's AI Compute Soars! SpaceXAI Adds 660,000 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs This Year, Total Near 1.44 Million
paras: 馬斯克的人工智慧（AI）算力布局持續擴張。馬斯克近日在X平台公布，SpaceX(SPCX-US) 旗下AI事業SpaceXAI今年內將新增66萬顆輝達(NVDA-US) GB300 GPU，使GPU總持有量逼近144萬顆，甚至超過其兩年前提出的「百萬GPU」目標。
根據馬斯克公布的數據，SpaceXAI目前旗下Colossus 1配備15萬顆H100、5萬顆H200及3萬顆GB200；Colossus 2則配置11萬顆GB200及44萬顆GB300。
馬斯克表示，另有22萬顆GB300將於下周全面投入運作，另外22萬顆預計11月上線，若進度順利，12月底前還將再增加22萬顆GB300。
屆時，SpaceXAI的GB300總數將達110萬顆，GPU總持有量則達144萬顆。

Colossus 2全面採用Blackwell架構

隨著算力持續擴充，SpaceXAI在成立僅3年後，已建立大規模AI算力集群。相較之下，Anthropic成立約6年、OpenAI則成立約10年。
馬斯克透露，Colossus 1混用Hopper與Blackwell兩種架構，導致Grok模型訓練效率不佳，因此目前已出租給Anthropic執行推理任務。
至於Colossus 2則全面採用Blackwell架構，馬斯克表示，這樣的配置可避免訓練過程出現瓶頸。
不過，對SpaceXAI而言，持續取得GPU並非擴建資料中心面臨的最大限制，電力供應才是另一項關鍵問題。
SpaceXAI目前正建設一座1.2吉瓦（GW）的自有發電廠，為大規模AI算力集群提供電力。透過自建發電設施，公司可避開電網接入所需的長時間審批流程。
但這項做法也引發當地爭議。SpaceXAI因使用未取得許可的燃氣渦輪發電設備而面臨訴訟，並已承諾在一年內逐步拆除這些臨時發電設備，同時等待自有電廠完工啟用。

百萬GPU不是終點

大規模部署百萬顆GPU並非業界唯一案例。博通(AVGO-US) 2024年曾透露，旗下有3家超大規模客戶計劃在2027年前達成類似規模。
但對馬斯克而言，百萬顆GPU只是更大規模擴張的起點。他表示，SpaceXAI計劃在2027年將資料中心容量擴大7倍，並設定2030年達到5000萬顆H100等效GPU的長期目標。
SpaceXAI的算力布局也不局限於地面資料中心。SpaceX另計劃發射由100萬顆衛星組成的軌道資料中心系統，不過輝達執行長黃仁勳對此表示，目前仍只是「一個夢想」。
SpaceXAI快速擴大算力規模，顯示AI基礎設施競爭已不只是GPU採購的較量。從自建發電設施、出租既有算力，到規劃軌道資料中心，馬斯克正同步擴大在能源與資料中心基礎設施方面的布局。
paras_en: Musk's artificial intelligence (AI) compute strategy continues to expand. He recently announced on X that SpaceX (SPCX-US) subsidiary SpaceXAI will add 660,000 NVIDIA (NVDA-US) GB300 GPUs this year, bringing its total GPU holdings close to 1.44 million, even surpassing the "one‑million GPU" target he set two years ago.
According to Musk's data, SpaceXAI's Colossus 1 currently houses 150,000 H100s, 50,000 H200s and 30,000 GB200s, while Colossus 2 is equipped with 110,000 GB200s and 440,000 GB300s.
Musk said another 220,000 GB300 GPUs will go live next week, an additional 220,000 are slated for November, and, if everything stays on schedule, another 220,000 will be added by the end of December.
At that point, SpaceXAI will have 1.1 million GB300 GPUs and a total of 1.44 million GPUs overall.

Colossus 2 adopts the Blackwell architecture throughout. With compute capacity continuously expanding, SpaceXAI has built a massive AI compute cluster in just three years, compared with Anthropic’s roughly six‑year history and OpenAI’s about ten years.

Musk revealed that Colossus 1 mixes Hopper and Blackwell architectures, which has hampered training efficiency for the Grok model, so it is currently being leased to Anthropic for inference workloads.
By contrast, Colossus 2 uses the Blackwell architecture exclusively, which Musk says avoids bottlenecks during training.
However, for SpaceXAI the biggest hurdle isn’t acquiring more GPUs but securing power supply.
SpaceXAI is constructing a 1.2‑gigawatt (GW) private power plant to feed its massive AI compute cluster, allowing the company to bypass the lengthy approval process required for grid connections.

The approach has sparked local controversy: SpaceXAI faces lawsuits over unpermitted gas‑turbine generators and has pledged to dismantle the temporary units within a year while awaiting completion of its own plant.
A million GPUs is not the end point. Broadcom (AVGO-US) disclosed in 2024 that three of its ultra‑large customers aim to reach a similar scale by 2027.

For Musk, a million GPUs is just the start of a larger expansion. He says SpaceXAI plans to increase data‑center capacity seven‑fold by 2027 and targets the equivalent of 50 million H100 GPUs by 2030.

SpaceXAI’s compute strategy isn’t limited to ground‑based data centers. SpaceX also plans to launch an orbital data‑center system composed of one million satellites, though NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang calls the idea “still a dream” for now.

The rapid scaling of SpaceXAI’s compute power shows that AI infrastructure competition now goes beyond GPU procurement, encompassing private power generation, leasing existing compute, and even planning orbital data centers as Musk expands his footprint in energy and data‑center infrastructure.

items.title: 印度挺主權AI馬來西亞籲開發中國家掌握技術主導權
items.title_en: India Backs Sovereign AI While Malaysia Calls for Developing Nations to Own Technological Direction
paras: 2026年09月27日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 印度在聯合國大會表態支持各國自主發展人工智慧(AI)模型，主張技術發展應符合各國需求，避免控制權集中於少數政府與企業。馬來西亞則強調，開發中國家不能只提供資料中心所需的土地、水與能源，卻缺乏參與技術決策及分享經濟利益的機會。
印度外長蘇杰生(S. Jaishankar)26日在聯合國大會總辯論中表示，AI有能力改善民眾生活、推動經濟繁榮，各國應有權依照自身發展重點建立AI模型。他也提醒，AI遭到不當使用，可能加深偏見、侵蝕社會相互尊重的基礎。
馬來西亞外長哈山(Mohamad Hasan)將焦點放在AI產業的利益分配。他表示，全球南方國家應參與技術創新，不能僅成為海外科技公司的客戶、市場或資料中心設置地點，卻讓AI發展方向由其他國家的政府與企業決定。
哈山指出，少數私人企業已對全球數十億人的通訊、工作、交易與資訊取得方式具有龐大影響力。資料中心及其他科技基礎設施對水、能源與土地的需求，也應納入討論，避免開發中國家承擔資源成本，主要經濟利益卻流向海外。
德國同樣關切AI技術所有權過度集中的問題。德國外長瓦德福(Johann Wadephul)表示，全球大多數AI專利掌握在兩個主要國家的企業手中，呼籲各國針對能力最強的AI模型建立共同安全要求，讓國際治理跟上技術發展速度。
新加坡則主張同步投資科學、基礎設施與人才技能，並建立確保人類保有控制權的保障措施。沙烏地阿拉伯也介紹推動國際AI能力建構中心網絡，以及在利雅德設立AI研究與倫理中心的工作。
貝里斯總理布里仙紐(John Briceño)表示，妥善治理AI有助改善公共服務、擴大知識取得機會；若缺乏管理，也可能加深不平等、衝擊就業，讓開發中國家依賴由海外制定的技術與規則。他認為，AI跨越國界，僅靠各國國內立法不足以因應。
聯合國已於2024年通過《全球數位契約》，推動AI國際合作、縮小數位落差，並促進安全、以人為本的科技發展。目前各國仍在討論，如何將共同原則轉化為可執行的規範。

paras_en: September 27, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – India told the United Nations General Assembly that countries should be free to develop their own artificial‑intelligence (AI) models, arguing that technology should serve each nation’s needs and not be concentrated in the hands of a few governments and corporations. Malaysia stressed that developing countries should not only provide land, water and energy for data centres but also have a say in technology decisions and share in the economic benefits.

India’s foreign minister S. Jaishankar said in the UNGA’s general debate on the 26th that AI can improve people’s lives and drive economic prosperity, and that every country should have the right to build AI models aligned with its own development priorities. He warned that misuse of AI could deepen bias and erode the foundations of mutual social respect.

Malaysia’s foreign minister Mohamad Hasan focused on the distribution of AI industry benefits. He said Global South nations must take part in technological innovation and should not be reduced to merely customers, markets or sites for overseas tech firms’ data centres while the direction of AI development is set by other countries’ governments and companies.

Hasan noted that a handful of private firms now wield massive influence over how billions of people communicate, work, transact and access information. The water, energy and land demands of data centres and other tech infrastructure should also be part of the discussion, to prevent developing nations from bearing resource costs while the main economic gains flow abroad.

Germany shares concerns about excessive concentration of AI technology ownership. German foreign minister Johann Wadephul said most AI patents are held by companies in just two major countries and called for common safety standards for the most powerful AI models so that international governance can keep pace with technological progress.

Singapore advocates simultaneous investment in science, infrastructure and talent skills, and the creation of safeguards that ensure humanity retains control. Saudi Arabia also outlined plans to build a network of international AI capability‑building centres and to establish an AI research and ethics hub in Riyadh.

Belize Prime Minister John Briceño said proper AI governance can improve public services and expand access to knowledge, but a lack of oversight could worsen inequality, disrupt employment and make developing countries dependent on overseas‑set technology and rules. He believes AI transcends borders and domestic legislation alone is insufficient.

The United Nations adopted the Global Digital Compact in 2024 to promote international AI cooperation, narrow the digital divide and foster safe, human‑centred technology development. Nations are still debating how to turn the shared principles into enforceable regulations.

items.title: 南韓股市資金換擋！散戶8月撤資13.5兆韓元、KOSPI下輪行情由誰主宰？
paras: 南韓股市今年上半年在散戶資金與人工智慧（AI）熱潮推動下強勢上漲，但近期散戶資金持續撤出，市場資金結構正逐步轉變。
南韓新榮證券（Shinyoung Securities）研究中心負責人Kim Hak-kyun指出，散戶先前抵銷外資賣壓的局面正在改變，未來南韓綜合股價指數（KOSPI）能否反彈，外資動向將成為重要關鍵。
Kim於近日表示，今年上半年南韓散戶投資人龐大的資金流入，曾有效抵銷外資撤出，但目前散戶資金流向已出現明顯變化，後續供需結構將與上半年不同。
根據Kim對實際資金流動的估算，包括尚未結算交易及融資融券等資金，南韓散戶8月從國內股市淨流出13.5兆韓元（約97億美元）。截至9月18日，9月累計淨流出也達9.83兆韓元（約71億美元），日均流出規模甚至超過8月。
Kim指出，與過去不同的是，近期散戶資金在市場回檔後仍持續流出，反映散戶投資人在短期劇烈波動中受到較大衝擊。

中東局勢、油價與美債殖利率牽動外資

展望未來，Kim認為，未來中東戰事、全球油價及美國長期利率，將成為影響外資是否重返韓股的重要因素。
他表示，如果中東局勢緩和，油價趨於穩定，同時美國長期公債殖利率回落，全球資金可能重新配置至非美元資產，進而有利外資流入南韓市場。
此外，韓元貶值趨勢近期有所緩解，加上外資已大幅降低韓股持倉，也提高未來市場供需改善的可能性。
Kim並強調，市場更應關注由市場決定的長期利率，而非聯準會（Fed）是否進一步調整基準利率。他認為，近期美國長期殖利率走高，主要受到中東戰事造成財政赤字擴大及油價上漲影響，而非經濟過熱或潛在通膨壓力。
因此，中東戰事後續發展可能透過油價、長期殖利率及外資資金流向等渠道，進一步影響南韓股市。

高槓桿資金退潮 加劇韓股回檔

回顧今年韓股走勢，散戶及槓桿資金曾是推動市場上漲的重要力量。受全球AI資本支出上修及記憶體價格持續上漲帶動，KOSPI指數自年初約4200點一路走高，6月中旬一度突破9000點，年內漲幅達一倍。
其中，記憶體晶片族群漲勢尤其強勁。根據國海證券分析，SK海力士與三星電子2026年上半年股價分別上漲307.8%及179.1%，兩家公司合計市值占KOSPI總市值比重，也從年初約35%最高升至6月25日約57%。
伴隨股市大漲，南韓散戶資金大量進場。截至6月24日，南韓本土股票交易帳戶數達1.0877億個，而南韓總人口僅5000多萬人，且大量資金透過高槓桿ETF進入市場。
然而，槓桿交易的風險也在7月市場反轉後迅速浮現。KOSPI展開大幅修正，一度跌破5300點，較年內高點接近腰斬。
南韓監管機構隨後密集採取措施。7月16日，南韓金融監管機構宣布暫停新的單一股票槓桿ETF上市，並將最低保證金從1000萬韓元提高至3000萬韓元，且限制為現金。
7月29日，在KOSPI連續兩日觸發熔斷後，南韓再推出第二階段措施，包括限制槓桿ETF占投資人整體投資組合的最高比例，以及提高交易成本以抑制投機交易。
中信證券8月初發布報告指出，韓股融資餘額從6月24日高峰的38.6兆韓元，降至8月3日的27.4兆韓元，單月減少約11兆韓元，降幅達29%，抹平2月至6月半導體行情期間累積的槓桿增量。
中信證券表示，韓股融資餘額高峰雖僅占全市場總市值不到1%，但槓桿高度集中於單一板塊，使市場回檔時相關槓桿風險更加突出。此外，南韓場外市場還存在CFD、證券擔保貸款及場外選擇權／TRS等其他槓桿工具，並未完全反映在融資餘額數據中。
同時，兩倍做多個股ETF的上市，改變了尾部風險的傳導路徑，多空極端失衡，尾盤強平規則易引發螺旋式踩踏。
近期KOSPI主要在6800至7100點區間震盪，盤中衝高後回落的走勢也頻繁出現。

外資能否回流成市場下一個變數

隨著散戶資金持續流出、高槓桿資金大幅收縮，外資是否重新進場，成為韓股後續行情的重要觀察焦點。
美銀證券南韓研究主管Simon Woo表示，晶片企業長期協議及股東回報改善，可能成為下一階段吸引全球資金回流南韓科技股的催化因素。
Woo在9月21日受訪時表示，如果長期協議落地，市場可能認為亞洲科技股的週期性降低、風險也隨之下降。此外，提高股息率及股票回購等措施，也可能吸引投資人重新布局AI相關個股。
摩根大通9月21日發布報告，維持三星電子「增持」評級及40萬韓元目標價，認為其中期風險報酬仍具吸引力。
該行指出，三星電子第三季業績預覽顯示記憶體業務營運維持強勁，但韓元升值帶來匯兌逆風，因此下調公司獲利預測。
另一方面，瑞銀近日將KOSPI未來12個月目標點位從8800點下調至8000點，並將隱含本益比從8倍降至7倍，主要考量利率走高、韓元升值及油價上漲等因素。

items.title: Akamai百億美元合約帶動備料Jabil、聯想供應鏈浮上檯面
items.title_en: Akamai's $10 Billion Contract Boosts Jabil and Lenovo Supply Chains
paras: 2026年09月27日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Akamai(AKAM-US)與Anthropic簽下七年、116億美元雲端服務合約，股價上漲3.2%。合約並附帶認股權，Anthropic未來最高可取得Akamai約5%股權。
隨著採購安排陸續公布，Jabil與聯想在這項建置計畫中的角色也逐漸明朗。Akamai已授權Jabil(JBL-US)依既有服務協議採購約17億美元記憶體零組件，並與聯想旗下Lenovo Global Technologies簽訂硬體、軟體及相關服務總協議，為後續算力擴充展開備料與設備採購安排。
Jabil主要提供委託製造及相關服務，這次除記憶體採購授權外，雙方也在既有協議下新增製造需求。聯想則納入硬體與服務供應體系，但實際設備數量、合約金額及交貨時程尚未揭露。目前已知採購安排以記憶體備料最為具體，記憶體原廠名單仍待確認。
Akamai將部署CPU支應這筆合約，至於採用AMD(AMD-US)、英特爾(INTC-US)的處理器，或由兩家公司共同供貨，目前尚未確認。分析師推測，相關設備可能用於AI推論，但實際用途與配置仍待公司進一步說明。
為支應Anthropic合約，Akamai規畫投入約55億美元資本支出，其中2026年資本支出將增加約17億美元，用於預先取得記憶體等關鍵零組件。
Akamai的業務涵蓋資安、內容傳遞與雲端運算。市場預估，2026年資安營收約24.6億美元，占總營收約55%；內容傳遞及其他雲端應用約15.6億美元，占35%；雲端基礎設施服務約4.7億美元，占約10%。公司長期協助客戶加快網站、影音及軟體傳輸，並已提供運算、儲存、網路與應用程式部署服務。這些既有平台與服務能力，使其能透過增加伺服器容量，承接Anthropic持續成長的CPU運算需求。
隨著Anthropic合約進入備料與設備部署階段，Jabil採購執行、聯想設備交付，以及CPU與記憶體供應商名單，將是掌握供應鏈出貨進度的重點，也有助於判斷雲端基礎設施業務何時開始擴大營收貢獻。

paras_en: September 27, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – Akamai (AKAM-US) signed a seven‑year, $11.6 billion cloud‑services contract with Anthropic, sending its shares up 3.2%. The deal includes a warrant that could allow Anthropic to acquire up to about 5% of Akamai’s equity in the future.

As procurement details are released, Jabil’s and Lenovo’s roles in the build‑out become clearer. Akamai has authorized Jabil (JBL-US) to purchase roughly $1.7 billion of memory components under an existing services agreement, and has signed a master hardware, software and related services agreement with Lenovo Global Technologies, a Lenovo subsidiary, to begin material and equipment sourcing for the upcoming compute expansion.

Jabil will mainly provide contract manufacturing and related services; beyond the memory purchase authorization, the parties have added new manufacturing demand under the existing agreement. Lenovo is being incorporated into the hardware and services supply chain, though the exact equipment quantities, contract value and delivery schedule have not been disclosed. So far, the most concrete procurement detail is the memory stock‑piling, while the list of memory manufacturers remains to be confirmed.

Akamai will deploy CPUs to support the contract. Whether the processors will come from AMD (AMD-US), Intel (INTC-US), or a combination of both has not yet been determined. Analysts speculate the equipment may be used for AI inference, but the specific use cases and configurations await further clarification from the company.

To support the Anthropic deal, Akamai plans to spend about $5.5 billion on capital expenditures, with 2026 capital spending rising by roughly $1.7 billion to secure key components such as memory in advance.

Akamai’s business spans cybersecurity, content delivery and cloud computing. Market estimates project 2026 cybersecurity revenue at about $2.46 billion, roughly 55% of total revenue; content delivery and other cloud applications at about $1.56 billion, or 35%; and cloud infrastructure services at about $470 million, or 10%. The company long‑term helps customers accelerate website, video and software delivery, and already offers compute, storage, networking and application‑deployment services. These existing platforms and capabilities enable it to add server capacity to meet Anthropic’s growing CPU compute demand.

As the Anthropic contract moves into the material‑stocking and equipment‑deployment phase, Jabil’s procurement execution, Lenovo’s equipment deliveries, and the lists of CPU and memory suppliers will be key to tracking supply‑chain shipment progress and gauging when cloud‑infrastructure revenue will begin to lift overall earnings.
